cohort: 254 neonates delivered at a tertiary care hospital in Coastal Karnataka, India, born to mothers with PROM; mean maternal age 28.57+/-4.3 years
finding: PROM is associated with a significant risk of neonatal morbidity and mortality, with the most common complications being prematurity and low birth weight, and prolonged PROM increases the risk of neonatal complications.
mod_finding: While 59% of cases delivered vaginally, emergency C-section was the mode of delivery in 97% of Cesarean cases.
gest_age: 28-32 weeks (highest median latency period observed in this group)
birth_weight: low birth weight (mentioned as a complication)
